headline: 48-Unit Multifamily — Mission Valley, San Diego — $10.95M at 6.33% Cap
summary: Stable 48-unit Mission Valley community with in-place rents roughly 8% under market — the upside is in the rent roll.
description: Hillcrest Gardens Apartments offers 48 units in San Diego's Mission Valley submarket at $10,950,000, a 6.33% capitalization rate on in-place net operating income of $692,800.

Built in 1987, the community comprises 28 one-bedroom and 20 two-bedroom units across 41,280 rentable square feet. Occupancy held at 93.6% through the trailing twelve months while in-place rents remained approximately 8% below market, giving the next owner a mark-to-market path as leases roll.
Offers are due August 14, 2026. The offering memorandum is available upon execution of a confidentiality agreement.
